AEON-657.title: Agents session list: host pill fits its name (drop the fixed 104 px width)
AEON-657.description:
The host pill in the Agents session list (Host column) leaves empty space to the right of short names such as "mbp2607". Markus spotted it on 2026-10-03.

**Cause:** in `web/src/components/agents/SessionHost.vue`, `.host-badge` has a fixed `width: 104px`, with the icon and name left-aligned inside it. The rename pencil sits outside the pill (`position: absolute; left: calc(100% + 2px)`), so the reserved width serves nothing. It also breaks the UI bar rule "no fixed pixel widths on buttons that hold variable text".

**Fix:** size the pill to its content: `width: auto; max-width: 160px`. Long names keep the ellipsis, and the full name stays in the existing tooltip. The width changes only after a rename, never while someone works.
